issues.title: Fill word in function sizes, and PAL objects in the US relocation audit
issues.author: farfeduc
issues.body:
Two cases where C that builds to retail's bytes still fails the audits. I kept the functions out of my PRs; reporting them here so the tools can decide.
1. A trailing 0xCDCDCDCD fill word counts in the function's size
config/us/functions.tsv gives these level functions a size that includes one 0xCDCDCDCD word after the last jr $ra and its delay slot:
